limitations: Map truth transport is a diagnostic counterfactual, never runtime input or a replacement accuracy score.
Map accuracy work is deferred at Xian request; shared relocalization/loop components do not establish improved loop recall or map consistency without a separate test.
No acceptance, matching objective, candidate count, iteration limit, input frequency, map or simulator changes.
Difficult-search average half-core remains an open target.
